name: Hikawa Yuka
source:
Yuka is the protagonist's girlfriend who used to be his junior in high school and the manager of the soccer club to which Shougo belonged. She is now a 2nd year university student and studies in the National Literature department. Yuka's family owns a shrine where she helps out as a shrine maiden from time to time.  For some reason she seems to be anxious about Shougo going to work part-time for the Kidouin family. 

[Translated from Getchu,]
